understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to complete each KA59 level by moving the selectable piece(s) onto all goal tiles marked '+' so that every goal is occupied simultaneously, progressing through all levels until the game reports WIN.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement actions (up/down/left/right) attempt to shift the currently selected piece by one grid cell (3 pixels) per move; if a wall/boundary or other blocking object is in the way, the piece may not move. Some adjacent objects are pushable blocks that can be pushed in the move direction when contacted, provided the space beyond is free. Levels can contain multiple selectable pieces; control can be switched by CLICKing the other selectable's exact pixel coordinates from the state. The movement_blocked flags are only hints and do not guarantee an action will or will not succeed.

understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to complete each KA59 level by moving the selectable piece(s) onto all goal tiles marked '+' so that every goal is occupied simultaneously, progressing through all levels until the game reports WIN.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement actions (up/down/left/right) attempt to shift the currently selected piece by one grid cell (3 pixels) per move; if a wall/boundary or other blocking object is in the way, the piece may not move. Some adjacent objects are pushable blocks that can be pushed in the move direction when contacted, provided the space beyond is free. Levels can contain multiple selectable pieces; control can be switched by CLICKing the other selectable's exact pixel coordinates from the state. The movement_blocked flags are only hints and do not guarantee an action will or will not succeed.
